      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range c.K, xs.arrays.A row.val k *
        ((Real.nibble (xs.arrays.Q (k / 8) column.val) k -
          Real.nibble (xs.arrays.Z (k / c.group) (column.val / 8)) column.val) *
            xs.arrays.S (k / c.group) column.val))
